responsibility: Implements LRA’s largest and central RTL transformation pass for satisfying insn and address constraints, along with the inheritance/split pass and the undo pass for failed inheritance or split decisions. It chooses insn alternatives, creates reload insns and reload pseudos, substitutes equivalent constants or memory values, performs EBB-scoped inheritance and live-range splitting transformations, tracks optional reloads, and later restores original code when assigned hard registers make the transformation unprofitable or impossible. This is the main constraint-solving and RTL-rewriting engine of LRA.
